# -health names the cause when NVML is lost, without a CUDA context.
[!exec:sh] skip
chmod 0755 bin/nvidia-smi
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH
! exec cudadoctor -health -json
stdout '"name": "gpu-health"'
stdout 'NVML failed through nvidia-smi \(exit 255\): Failed to initialize NVML: Unknown Error'

-- bin/nvidia-smi --
#!/bin/sh
echo 'Failed to initialize NVML: Unknown Error'
exit 255
